data.one_liner: Maybe monad implementation with eager execution in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Maybe monad with Just and Nothing implementations to handle nullable values, transformations, filtering, and fallback chains eagerly in Dart.
use_when: You want to handle nullable values functionally without traditional null checks
You need fallback chains or map/flatMap operations on optional values
avoid_when: You don't need monads for null safety in modern Dart
strengths: Simple API with Just and Nothing
Supports mapping, flatMap, filtering, and fallback chains
weaknesses: Monads can be overkill for modern Dart null safety
